//: Committed maintainer dev settings for the ESF Companion repo. These PostToolUse hooks are maintainer-only quality gates; they are NOT part of the product. install.sh fetches shipped hooks (esf-session-status.sh, esf-update-check.sh) by explicit name and never reads this file, so nothing here reaches end users. Each hook is path-gated and fail-open: it no-ops unless the edit touches its target files, and never blocks the session except to feed a real error back to Claude (exit 2). Personal-only overrides still belong in the gitignored settings.local.json.
